name: IIS Header Injection Authentication Bypass
description: Microsoft IIS 10.0 improperly processes X-HTTP-Method-Override, X-Original-URL, X-Forwarded-For headers allowing authentication bypass. CVSS 9.8. MSRC Case 124937.
x_mitre_detection: Monitor 405→200 anomalies. Alert on X-HTTP-Method-Override, X-Original-URL, X-Forwarded-For headers.
